SELECT DISTINCT r."id", r."name", r."address", r."service_format", r."hours"
FROM "restaurant" r
WHERE r."service_format" IN ('буфет', 'кофейня')
  AND (
    
    r."hours" ~ '^(0?[7-9]|1[0-5]):[0-5][0-9]\s*[ap]m\s*-\s*(0?[7-9]|1[0-6]):[0-5][0-9]\s*[ap]m$'
    AND (
      
      CASE
        WHEN r."hours" ILIKE '%am%' AND r."hours" ILIKE '%pm%' THEN
          
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 2), 'am', 1)::integer) >= 450
          AND
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 2), 'pm', 1)::integer) <= 960
        WHEN r."hours" ILIKE '%am%' THEN
          
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 2), 'am', 1)::integer) >= 450
          AND
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 2), 'am', 1)::integer) <= 960
        WHEN r."hours" ILIKE '%pm%' THEN
          
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 2), 'pm', 1)::integer + 720) >= 450
          AND
          (SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 1)::integer * 60 +
           SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 2), 'pm', 1)::integer + 720) <= 960
      END
    )
  );

WITH ny_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    WHERE LOWER(c."name") = 'new york'
),
swimming_pools AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'swimming pool'
    GROUP BY h."id", h."name"
),
hot_tubs AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'hot tub'
    GROUP BY h."id", h."name"
)

SELECT
    'Swimming Pools' AS "feature_type",
    sp."name" AS "hotel_name"
FROM swimming_pools sp
JOIN ny_hotels nh ON sp."id" = nh."id"

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Hot Tubs' AS "feature_type",
    ht."name" AS "hotel_name"
FROM hot_tubs ht
JOIN ny_hotels nh ON ht."id" = nh."id";

SELECT DISTINCT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    CASE
        WHEN lf."feature" = 'swimming pool' THEN 'swimming pool'
        WHEN lf."feature" = 'hot tub' THEN 'hot tub'
    END AS feature_type,
    c."name" AS city_name
FROM
    "hotel" h
JOIN
    "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
JOIN
    "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
JOIN
    "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
JOIN
    "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
WHERE
    (lf."feature" = 'swimming pool' OR lf."feature" = 'hot tub')
    AND c."name" = 'New York'
ORDER BY
    h."name", feature_type;
